## What is this project

**NCLEX-PN remediation planner** — a personal study tool to track exam weak areas, generate remediation plans, and keep a learning journal. Stored in plain JSON files so you can edit it anywhere (phone, text editor, etc.).

## Rules in effect

| Rule | Constraint |
|------|-----------|
| **rule** | Plain JSON only — no database |
| **rule** | Never store actual paid-qbank questions (UWorld, Archer, Kaplan) — topic tags and own notes only |
| **rule** | All content must be PN scope of practice: reinforce, monitor, report, follow care plan — never independently assess or initiate treatment (that's RN scope) |
| **rule** | Keep it personal — don't package, post to GitHub, or share publicly yet |
| **rule** | Gamification stays parked (no streaks, leaderboards) |
| **rule** *(exception)* | One counter allowed: "days studied in a row" in summary line for personal motivation only |
